name: US Government Crypto Wallet
rootCause: According to a MistTrack tweet, a suspicious outflow was detected from a wallet controlled by the U.S. government (0xc9E...34c): nearly $20 million was transferred to 0x3486ee700ccaf3e2f9c5ec9730a2e916a4740a9f, including: 5.4M USDC, 1.12M USDT, 13.7M aUSDC and 178 ETH. Most tokens were swapped into ETH. Approximately 19.3M worth of tokens were later returned to the U.S. government address.

descriptions.text: On 2024-10-24, roughly $20 million in USDC, USDT, aUSDC, and ETH moved from a U.S. government linked Ethereum wallet associated with seized Bitfinex assets. Public reporting and on-chain monitoring flagged the transfers as unauthorized, but the exact authorization failure has not been publicly established. Most reports later stated that approximately $19.3 million was returned within a day. The exact authorization failure remains unknown. Public reporting described the event as a likely wallet compromise affecting a U.S. government linked Ethereum address that held seized Bitfinex assets. Most tokens were swapped into ETH. Approximately 19.3M worth of tokens were later returned to the U.S. government address.
